model: MBDMX-PLUS (Heavy Duty DMX Mirror Ball Motor)
notes: Not a fog machine: a mirror-ball motor with two switched 3-prong Edison sockets for pinspots (ch1 switches those sockets, so 'Lamp' is whatever pinspots are plugged in; the unit has no light source of its own, hence optics=null). Power figure is the motor draw only (10.5 W at 5 rpm, 10.2 W at 0.5 rpm) and excludes anything plugged into the pinspot sockets. Dimensions given by ADJ as 8 x 4.8 x 5.75 in; mapped W=203, L=122, H=146. Standalone speed via dip switches; primary/secondary sync for up to 16 units. Repo channel map (ch1 Lamp, ch2 Rotation) matches the manual exactly. No GDTF-share entry located (gdtf-share.com requires login; nothing surfaced via search).
